high.title: Let's get you support right now
suicide: I'm really glad you told me. What you're describing sounds serious, and you deserve support from a real person right now.
If you might act on these thoughts or are in immediate danger, please contact emergency services or go to the nearest hospital emergency department now.
If you can, tell someone you trust how you're feeling and ask them to stay with you.
self_harm: Thank you for telling me. You deserve care and support from a real person right now.
If you have hurt yourself or might do so soon, please contact emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department.
If you can, reach out to someone you trust and let them know what's happening.
harm_to_others: It sounds like things feel very intense right now.
If you feel you might hurt someone, please put distance between yourself and the situation and contact emergency services or a crisis line now.
Talking to a trained person can help you get through this moment safely.
medical_emergency: This sounds like it could be a medical emergency.
Please contact emergency services right now or go to the nearest emergency department. If someone is nearby, ask them to help you.
unsafe_situation: Your safety matters most right now.
If you are in danger, please contact emergency services. If you can, move to a safer place or go to someone you trust.
severe_disorientation: It sounds like things feel very confusing right now.
Please ask someone nearby to help you, and contact emergency services or a doctor as soon as possible.
high.ai_notice: I'm an AI wellbeing companion and can't provide emergency or crisis care. Reaching a person now is the most important step.
high.no_local_resources: Please contact your local emergency number or go to the nearest hospital emergency department.

concerning.title: Support is available
default: It sounds like things have been really hard lately.
You don't have to carry this alone. Talking with someone you trust, or with a mental health professional, could help.
If things get worse or you ever feel unsafe, support is available at any time.
unusual_experiences: Experiences like that can feel unsettling.
I can't tell what's behind them, but a doctor or mental health professional can help you understand what's going on. It may be worth arranging an assessment soon.
functioning: When sleep, eating or getting through the day stay this hard for a while, it's worth checking in with a doctor or mental health professional.
In the meantime, we can keep things very small and manageable.
third_party_risk: It sounds like you're worried about someone's safety. That's a lot to hold.
If they may be in immediate danger, contact emergency services. You can also call a helpline yourself for guidance on how to support them.
abuse: No one deserves to be hurt.
If you are in danger, contact emergency services. A helpline can talk through options with you confidentially.

reply.fallback: Thanks for sharing that. I'm not able to put together a full reply right now, but here's one small thing that might help: {title}. {summary}
reply.guarded: Thanks for telling me. I'm not able to give medical or diagnostic advice — a doctor or mental health professional is the right person for that. If it's useful, here's one small thing you could try: {title}.
